qualified_parent_foundation_preserved.rule: The lifecycle amendment is additive architecture/control law. It does not relabel v1 exact-SHA qualification as proof of new substage semantics. A versioned executable successor is required if runtime enforcement changes beyond existing evidence-overlay compatibility.

current_parent_critical_path.objective: Define versioned target-medium publication/export profiles and evidence gates so EPUB, PDF, DOCX and print outputs are bound to exact canonical manuscript versions, verified in their actual rendered medium, accessibility/metadata requirements are explicit where applicable, and technical export/proof PASS remains separate from publication authorization.
must_include: common exact-version and deterministic artifact-digest binding
EPUB 3.3 conformance profile when EPUB is requested
EPUB Accessibility 1.1 / applicable WCAG-derived evidence and accessibility metadata
ONIX 3.1-compatible distribution metadata projection when needed
proof correction ledger and deterministic re-render/re-proof loop
must_not_do: assume one format's proof rules apply unchanged to another format
replace Book System canonical version/provenance with EPUB or ONIX metadata
equate successful rendering, validation or proofing with author publication approval
reopen literary structural/line editing silently during proof
resume Integration Proposal Runtime implementation before research remediation release

generic_continue_rule: In Book System control, Continue executes BOOK-SYSTEM-PUBLICATION-EXPORT-STANDARDS-PROFILE-001. Integration Proposal Runtime implementation remains paused.
qualification_effect: Control-state advancement only. No new runtime qualification, manuscript promotion, human/editor evidence, author decision or publication authority is created by State-008.
